integrity: Proof and exact-rational verification are supplied; finite checks are supporting only. No independent audit or external certification is claimed.
limitations: The lower bound concerns symmetric uniform-stationary stochastic chains on one-leaf coronas of connected noncomplete cores; optimality is constructed for balanced complete multipartite cores. For unbalanced complete bipartite cores only strict exceedance is shown, not its exact value. Publication-priority comparisons are qualified by incomplete specialist indexing and an inaccessible spectral source.
title: The four-fifths mixing barrier for one-leaf graph coronas
